Thus `jit doc dir <id> <undeclared-area> --json` and an unknown-ID invocation emit only the top-level plain-text `Error:` message, rather than a machine-readable JSON error. The command’s `--json` interface therefore does not cover its required rejection paths. Route these failures through JSON-aware error rendering and add CLI coverage for both error cases.
